Orange Balsamic Vinaigrette
By: Tiffany
Published: Wednesday, March 2, 2011 - 1:13pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup olive oil
1 orange, juiced
1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
1 tablespoon parsley, finely chopped
1 teaspoon sugar
1 teaspoon orange zest
salt and pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Combine all the ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well with a fork. 2 If you want it a little sweeter, add more orange juice. 3 Pour over your favorite salad. Perfect with pasta, asparagus and bean salad!
